sc_cat_item.description:
Assign Existing Card

Submit a request to create a new recognition card to acknowledge a colleague's impactful contributions and positive impact within the team or organization. This process provides a structured way to celebrate their achievements and reinforce a culture of appreciation.
sc_cat_item.name: Assign Recognition Card
sc_cat_item.short_description: Use this Item to formally submit a request for assignment of existing Recognition Card.
